INSERT INTO crm_wechat_mp_article_stat ( app_id, article_id, index_in_msg, ref_date, stat_date, read_user, share_user, zaikan_user, like_user, comment_count, collection_user, praise_money, read_subscribe_user, read_delivery_rate, read_finish_rate, read_avg_activetime ) VALUES
( #{row.appId}, #{row.articleId}, #{row.indexInMsg}, #{row.refDate}, #{row.statDate}, #{row.readUser}, #{row.shareUser}, #{row.zaikanUser}, #{row.likeUser}, #{row.commentCount}, #{row.collectionUser}, #{row.praiseMoney}, #{row.readSubscribeUser}, #{row.readDeliveryRate}, #{row.readFinishRate}, #{row.readAvgActivetime} )
ON CONFLICT (article_id, index_in_msg, stat_date) DO UPDATE SET read_user = EXCLUDED.read_user, share_user = EXCLUDED.share_user, zaikan_user = EXCLUDED.zaikan_user, like_user = EXCLUDED.like_user, comment_count = EXCLUDED.comment_count, collection_user = EXCLUDED.collection_user, praise_money = EXCLUDED.praise_money, read_subscribe_user = EXCLUDED.read_subscribe_user, read_delivery_rate = EXCLUDED.read_delivery_rate, read_finish_rate = EXCLUDED.read_finish_rate, read_avg_activetime = EXCLUDED.read_avg_activetime, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT article_id || ':' || index_in_msg AS stat_key, SUM(read_user) AS total_read, SUM(share_user) AS total_share, SUM(zaikan_user + like_user) AS total_like, SUM(comment_count) AS total_comment, SUM(collection_user) AS total_collect FROM crm_wechat_mp_article_stat WHERE app_id = #{appId} GROUP BY article_id, index_in_msg
